provenance.prompt: Create a new four-pose right-facing receive animation sheet for Keeg matching the attached accepted JAMVERSE gameplay sprite style and his exact identity. Adult human witch athlete, black hair and close neat black beard, whole very tall purple/silver hat decorated with mushrooms, purple lavender silver athletic kit, same proportions. Transparent RGBA 1536x1024 sheet, exactly four full body figures, strict 2x2 row-major cells, broad empty gutters and margins, aligned shoes. Crisp chunky 1990s arcade pixel sprite art; not smooth painting. The basketball is rendered at runtime by the game. Absolutely no basketball or other object in any frame. Critical hand construction for catch poses: palms face one another with a clear visible transparent empty gap between them; fingers are visibly separated, curved around an EMPTY SPACE, never touching or enclosing an object. At pose2 the game ball will be drawn into this gap separately. No sphere, circle, seam, ball, glow, orb, spell, prop, text, shadows, court, floor or ground. Poses: 0 eyes track incoming pass in relaxed balanced ready stance, open hands near waist; 1 step forward and raise separated open palms toward the incoming pass; 2 catch anchor at tick4, bring EMPTY open hands toward each other at chest, palms facing each other with unmistakably transparent empty space about basketball-sized between them, individually visible fingertips around perimeter but NO shape in the gap; 3 cushion catch, draw empty hands slightly closer while preserving the same completely clear EMPTY transparent gap, settle stable. Every frame entire hat and complete body, no edge clipping. Same outfit throughout. Do not draw background, panel, border or grid, only four figures with true transparent background. Return only the sprite sheet.

rejectedCandidates.reason: First initial sheet included baked basketball at catch and opaque atmospheric background.
Repeated initial generation still baked basketball at catch and atmospheric background.
Correction attempt removed visible ball detail but retained basketball-like clenched hands and did not yield a clear empty catch.

review.reviewNotes: Four complete human Keeg poses are isolated in row-major 2x2 cells with large gutters. Adult human anatomy, black hair, close black beard, complete tall purple hat with mushrooms and silver trim, and purple/lavender/silver kit match accepted action art. All hands remain empty; catch poses leave a visible transparent gap for the separate runtime ball. No pose touches the image edge. The separate Keeg receive track reaches the hands at catch frame2/tick4. Canon K.03 approves mirroring.
